headline: Mexico Utility CFE Posts $1.24 Billion Q3 Loss on Foreign Exchange
summary: Mexico's state power utility CFE swung to a third-quarter net loss of $1.24 billion from a $3.00 billion profit, driven by foreign-currency losses on its debt.
why: CFE is Mexico's state-owned electric utility and one of the largest corporate bond issuers in the country, making its balance sheet sensitive to currency fluctuations.

impacts.name: Comisión Federal de Electricidad
impacts.why: CFE swung to a $1.24 billion quarterly loss after reporting significant foreign exchange losses on debt.
